summary.intent: Run the GSD secure-phase workflow for Phase 44 (ipns-conflict-handling) to verify all STRIDE threat mitigations are covered, then run a CodeRabbit CLI review of the phase-44 diff and fix all findings.
summary.outcome: 44-SECURITY.md was created and committed with all 26 threats verified (19 mitigated, 7 accepted). CodeRabbit surfaced a critical data-loss bug in the 409 file-conflict merge path; all 4 findings were fixed, 196 tests pass, and 44-SECURITY.md was updated with a post-audit correction note.

repo: The gsd-security-auditor subagent writes its output to the repo-root SECURITY.md instead of the phase-scoped path — requires manual restoration and redirect every run.
Phase 44 spans feat/ipns-conflict-handling; phases 42, 43, and 44 are all stacked on that branch. Phase-44-only base commit is 150db25d9 (first phase-44 commit parent: 2db838ef6).
sdk-core dist/ is gitignored — build artifacts never enter commits.

updateFileMetadata stamps updatedMetadata.modifiedAt = Date.now() at publish (file/index.ts:270), making local almost always win latest-wins conflicts. Remote-wins path requires explicit far-future timestamp in tests.
lint-staged runs prettier on staged test files and folds the formatting into the commit automatically.
The GSD commit helper (gsd_run query commit) frequently returns commit_failed even when the commit lands — always verify with git log, never retry blindly.

code.finding: Critical data-loss bug: second arg to mergeVersions was hardcoded to remoteMeta.versions instead of loser.versions. When remote wins, loser is local metadata, so local version history was silently dropped. Fix: remoteMeta.versions → loser.versions.

With createVersion: false, loser.versions carries local history and loser.cid = local-cid. modifiedAt is overwritten to Date.now() at line 270, meaning remote must have a far-future timestamp to actually win in tests.

Pre-existing remote-wins test used empty local versions and never asserted history preservation — it passed with the bug present. Never actually exercised the remote-wins branch because of the modifiedAt stamp.
is409 was missing from the barrel export despite SUMMARY claiming it was re-exported. No external consumer existed yet, so it was a consistency gap rather than a functional break.
is409 uses optional chaining throughout — safe to call with null/undefined arguments without throwing.

workflow: CodeRabbit CLI (v0.5.4, `coderabbit review --base-sha <sha>`) scopes reviews to a specific commit range — essential for stacked branches where main..HEAD spans multiple phases.
After a security audit, immediately run a code review pass — auditors verify mitigation presence but don't catch implementation bugs in the mitigation code itself.
When a post-audit bug is found, update SECURITY.md with a post-audit findings subsection to keep the security record historically accurate rather than silently patching the original audit.
The short-circuit rule (threats_open: 0 AND register_authored_at_plan_time: true → skip auditor) only applies when mitigations are pre-verified; 19 unverified mitigates correctly bypassed it.

friction: gsd-security-auditor wrote its report to the repo-root SECURITY.md (public disclosure policy) instead of the phase-scoped path — required git diff inspection, git restore, and manual redirect. No guard in the workflow against this.
GSD commit helper returns commit_failed even on success — creates false alarm and requires git log verification every time.
The critical data-loss bug (T-44-09 / T-44-21) existed when the SECURED verdict was signed — the audit over-trusted test names without verifying test assertions covered both directions.
Shell glob errors in Bash when checking is409 usages required re-running the grep with corrected quoting.
The test fixture for the remote-wins regression test initially had the wrong winner because modifiedAt gets overwritten to Date.now() — required a second iteration with a far-future remote timestamp.
open_items: Re-run coderabbit review against final HEAD to confirm 0 remaining findings (was launching at end of transcript, result not shown).
The gsd-security-auditor root-SECURITY.md clobber issue should be fixed in the auditor prompt/constraints so it targets the phase-scoped path without manual intervention.
T-44-09 and T-44-21 in 44-SECURITY.md now reference the post-audit fix but the original audit register still shows CLOSED — consider whether future audits should re-verify patched threats.
is409 has no dedicated unit test in file.test.ts (only in folder-merge.test.ts after this session) — minor coverage gap if the two usages diverge.
